newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BRAZIL V ITALY FACTS AND FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BRAZIL V ITALY FACTS AND FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures relating to Sunday's match in the Tournoi de France between Brazil and Italy:
Brazil:
Football Association formed: 1914; Affiliated to FIFA: 1923. Major honours; World Champions: 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994. South American Champions: 1919, 1922, 1949, 1989.
National Stadium: Maracana Stadium, Rio de Janeiro, capacity: 150,000
Coach: Mario Zagallo
Record international appearances: Djalma Santos, 100 caps, 1952-1968
Record international scorer: Pele, 77 goals, 1957-1971
Italy:
Football Association formed: 1898; Affiliated to FIFA: 1905 (founder member).
Major honours: World Champions: 1934, 1938, 1982. European Champions: 1968
Coach: Cesare Maldini
Record international appearances: Dino Zoff, 112 caps, 1968- 1983
Record international scorer: Luigi Riva, 35 goals, 1965-1974
Previous meetings
Played 11
Wins: Italy 5, Brazil 5
Draws: one (1994 World Cup final; 0-0 after extra time, Brazil won penalty shootout)
Details:
June 16 1938 Marseille WC semifinal Italy 2, Brazil 1
April 24 1956 Milan Friendly Italy 3, Brazil 0
July 1 1956 Rio Friendly Brazil 2, Italy 0
May 12 1963 Milan Friendly Italy 3, Brazil 0
June 21 1970 Mexico City WC Final Brazil 4, Italy 1
June 9 1973 Rome Friendly Italy 2, Brazil 0
May 31 1976 New Haven US Bicentennial Brazil 4, Italy 1
June 24 1978 B.Aires WC 3/4 place Brazil 2, Italy 1
July 5 1982 Barcelona WC 2nd round Italy 3, Brazil 2
Oct.14 1989 Bologna Friendly Italy 0, Brazil 1
July 17 1995 Pasadena WC Final Brazil 0, Italy 0
(after extra time, Brazil won 3-2 on penalties)
